# `aitbc agent workflow list-workflows`

List all workflows registered with the coordinator.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent workflow list-workflows [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Agent coordinator URL (default: config agent_coordinator_url) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent workflow list-workflows
```
